maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is mainly subscriptions and licences for Creo CAD, Windchill PLM, ServiceMax and ThingWorx, sold to manufacturers for product development.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private manufacturers in automotive, industrial, medtech, electronics and aerospace; government is a minor share.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth comes mainly from its own CAD, PLM and SLM software; it makes only occasional acquisitions such as Arena and ServiceMax.

mission_critical.reason: Creo CAD and Windchill PLM hold core product data; switching means migration, retraining and requalification across engineering processes.
